actions.oldValue: Their first work under the banner of Two Sisters, their new company, is The Executrix, an inventive and slippery one-act by Horwitz, which Sarah Blush directs.
actions.newValue: Clifford Odets’ episodic, pro-union drama from 1935 still has plenty of potency even if Steven Pasquale’s staging struggles to maintain momentum.
